dict.string: 画质模式决定画布大小，以及画布要不要由 MetalFX 放大到面板；场景分辨率只影响 3D 世界，与画质模式独立。超分与抗锯齿在下一组。重启游戏后生效 · the picture mode sets the canvas and whether MetalFX upscales it to the panel; the scene resolution affects the 3D world only. Upscaling and anti-aliasing are in the next group. Takes effect after relaunching

array.string: MetalFX 2K（1080p 画布 + 输出超分，文字最清楚）· MetalFX 2K (1080p canvas + output upscaling, sharpest text)
原生 2K（烘焙画布，最清晰也最热）· Native 2K (baked canvas, sharpest and hottest)
1080p（画布原生，不做输出超分，更凉）· 1080p (native canvas, no output upscaling, cooler)

dict.string: MetalFX 2K：1080p 画布，最后由 MetalFX 放大到面板，文字更清楚；1080p：约 1919x1323 显示缓冲，不做输出超分，更凉；原生 2K：使用构建时烘焙的画布（默认构建面向 11 英寸 M5 iPad，2420x1668），文字真正原生，3D 仍按场景分辨率渲染，发热最高，其他面板自动回退；720p：更小缓冲，最省电。四个档位都不改变 3D 场景的渲染尺寸。 · MetalFX 2K: a 1080p canvas that MetalFX upscales to the panel for clearer text; 1080p: about a 1919x1323 drawable with no output upscaling, cooler; Native 2K: the canvas baked into this build (default: the 11-inch M5 iPad, 2420x1668) for native text (3D stays at the scene resolution; hottest; other panels fall back); 720p: a smaller drawable, lowest power. None of them changes the 3D scene's render size.

只影响 3D 世界，与画质模式独立。GPU 开销几乎与像素数成正比（2026-10-23 实测，60 帧档：960x540 12.9 ms，1280x720 26.2 ms）。大世界里 960x540 热机后会从 60 掉到 30；800x450 大约 8.9 ms，热机后仍能守住 60，代价是画面更软。 · Affects the 3D world only, independent of the picture mode. GPU cost is nearly linear in pixels (measured 2026-10-23 at 60 fps: 12.9 ms at 960x540, 26.2 ms at 1280x720). In heavy areas 960x540 drops from 60 to 30 once the SoC heats up; 800x450 costs about 8.9 ms and keeps 60, at the price of a softer picture.

array.string: 填满屏幕 · Fill the screen

dict.string: 填满屏幕不拉伸画面：相机按屏幕比例取景，呈现时再还原比例。iPad 比 16:9 窄，所以两侧会少一点、上下填满；16:9 保留完整宽度并加黑边。少数 UI 特效可能偏移（实验性）· fill does not stretch: the camera takes the screen's aspect and the present pass restores the proportions. An iPad is narrower than 16:9, so a little is lost at the sides and the height is filled; 16:9 keeps the full width with bars. A few UI effects may sit off (experimental)

管线：场景按「场景分辨率」渲染 → 场景超分 → 画布 → 输出超分（由画质模式决定）→ 面板。两段超分都是 MetalFX 空间放大，不增加帧延迟；边缘平滑是 MetalFX 的时间抗锯齿。重启游戏后生效 · pipeline: the scene renders at the scene resolution → scene upscaling → canvas → output upscaling (set by the picture mode) → panel. Both stages are MetalFX spatial scaling with no added latency; edge smoothing is MetalFX temporal anti-aliasing. Takes effect after relaunching

把 3D 场景用 MetalFX 放大到画布（场景 → 画布这一段）：画面更锐，实测 GPU 代价不到 0.2 ms；关掉画面会明显变软。原生 2K 下由游戏自己的缩放填充画布，此开关不生效。重启游戏后生效 · MetalFX upscales the 3D scene into the canvas (the scene → canvas stage): sharper for under 0.2 ms of GPU in our measurements; off is visibly softer. With Native 2K the game's own scaler fills the canvas, so the switch does nothing. Takes effect after relaunching
边缘平滑（MetalFX 时间抗锯齿）· Edge smoothing (MetalFX TAA)
对 3D 画面做时间性抗锯齿，边缘更稳；可能有轻微拖影，默认关闭。重启游戏后生效 · MetalFX temporal anti-aliasing of the 3D scene; slight ghosting is possible. Off by default; takes effect after relaunching

上限决定游戏每秒出多少帧。热机时会先掉到 30 帧、冷却一两分钟再回到 60；想要一直稳、一直凉就选 30。重启游戏后生效 · the cap sets how many frames the game renders per second. When the SoC heats up it drops to 30 for a minute or two, then returns to 60; pick 30 to stay steady and cool. Takes effect after relaunching
帧率上限 · Frame rate cap

30 最省电也最稳，长时间不变；60 推荐，发热后可能临时降到 30，冷却后自行回到 60；120 最顺滑也最热，需要 120 Hz 面板，60 Hz 设备自动回退到 60。重启游戏后生效 · 30 is the coolest and holds steady over time; 60 is recommended — after the SoC heats up the game may drop to 30 for a while and return to 60 once it cools; 120 is the smoothest and hottest and needs a 120 Hz panel (a 60 Hz device falls back to 60). Takes effect after relaunching

默认开启。首次启动会提示选择一次 iCloud Drive 文件夹；save 和 game-slot 会自动镜像过去，删 App 也不会丢。选「以后再说」后不再自动提示；要换文件夹，打开下面的开关。 · on by default. The first launch asks once for an iCloud Drive folder; save and game-slot are mirrored there and survive deleting the app. “Later” is remembered, so it does not ask again; to change the folder, turn on the switch below.
